grammar.intro_ar: بعد didn't و Did يرجع الفعل لأصله: I didn't go (وليس didn't went) · Did you see? (وليس Did you saw?).

rows: I didn't work. She didn't go.
Did you work? Did she go?

notes: Regular: + ed (worked, stayed) · study → studied · stop → stopped. Irregular verbs: learn them by heart (see the word sets).
Say -ed as /t/ (walked), /d/ (stayed) or /ɪd/ after t or d (visited, wanted).

write_speak: Write & Speak — “My last weekend”: write 8 sentences using first, then, after that and finally. Record yourself reading it.
other: Example: Last Friday was a great day. First, I got up late and had a big breakfast. Then I went to the mosque. After that, I visited my parents and we had lunch together. In the afternoon I met my friends at a café. We drank tea and talked. Finally, I came back home at ten. I was tired, so I went to bed early.
